title: Adaptive Cauchy inference from invariant information
summary: Selecting weights and projection directions from the observations used for testing can invalidate a reference distribution. We develop a framework for exact conditional inference under rotation symmetry. A maximal invariant permits adaptation while leaving a uniform common phase for calibration. This yields explicit Cauchy references for invariantly selected weights and projections. Under separate block rotations, the same principle gives exact normal-score combinations with coefficients selected from all blockwise invariants.
